<p style="padding-top:15px">'''Free Fire World Series''' ('''FFWS''' in short) is a [[Global_Events|Global]] tournament held biannually by [[Garena]].</p>

==About==
{{TextDropdown|section=Notes|title=For event notes|width=65%}}
{{Note||Note<sup>1</sup>:{{LeagueIconSmall/pro league cis}} [[Free Fire Pro League/CIS/Season 4|FFPL CIS Season 4]] cancelled.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.instagram.com/p/CbTO7sGMOmw/ |title=Было принято решение об отмене 4-го сезона FREE FIRE Pro League (FFPL) CIS в силу обстоятельств, делающих проведение турнира невозможным.|trans_title=It was decided to cancel the 4th season of the FREE FIRE Pro League (FFPL) CIS due to the inability to host the tournament. |date=2022-03-19|author='''Free Fire Esports CIS'''|language={{Flag|ru}} Rusian}}</ref> So teams from [[:Category:CIS|CIS]] can't participate in World Series.}}
<br>
{{note||Note<sup>2</sup>:{{LeagueIconSmall/india championship}} [[Free_Fire_India_Championship/2022/Spring|FFIC 2022 Spring]] postponed until further notice due to the Indian government's Free Fire ban. So teams from [[:Category:India|India]] can't participate in World Series.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.facebook.com/legendgarenafreefirevn/posts/296171446015927 |title=Ấn Độ và CIS là 2 khu vực sẽ không có mặt tại FFWS 2022 Sentosa |trans_title=India and CIS are two regions not participating in FFWS 2022 Sentosa |date=2022-04-20|author=''''Huyền Thoại Sinh Tồn - Free Fire'''|publisher=|language={{Flag|vn}} Vietnamese}}</ref>}}

===Format===
<big>'''FFWS 2022 - Sentosa:''' May 14th - May 21st, 2022 at the [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Resorts_World_Sentosa RWS Convention Centre], {{Flag|sg}} Sentosa.''</big>
:''18 Teams from 10 Regional Leagues
<div style="margin-top:20px"></div>
* '''Play-ins:''''' May 14th
** 10 teams.
** 6 matches.
** {{Bgcolortext|up|Top 4}} advance to the ''Finals''.
<div style="margin-top:10px"></div>
* '''Finals:''''' May 21st
** 12 teams:
*** 8 Teams directly invited
*** Top 4 from Play-ins
** 6 matches.
<br/>
{{Points12|showtb=true}}
